body.x: 4DCULTURE (CEO Kim Jong-sung, www.4dculture.com), an exhibit support company of Daegu Mobile Convergence Center, will participate in ‘2013 International Consumer Electronics Show(hear after ‘CES 2013’) held at US, Las Vegas, from Jan.8, 2013 to Jan.11 and introduce 3D scanning system.

‘3D Dental Scanner’ of 4DCULTURE makes accurate form information of the patient’s teeth for orthodontic appliance and false teeth production in 3D digital information and provides mutual trust dental information for the exchange between dental technology manufacturers and dentist. Also, as creating the cost reduction effect compared to existing cost, it reduces the burden on patients dental health spending and gives them psychological stability.

‘3D laser scanner(X-Scan)’ is specialized equipment for high-precision measurement required in the industry, shape comparison test and non-linear feature information acquisition in inline production line. It maintains the performance of the existing expensive imported products and serviceability of use and significantly removes the bubbles in product price.

By using a high-resolution camera, ‘Smart e Book Scanner’ can scan as well as shoot at the same time. You can scan up to B4 size with the scanner and copy the area by simply just clicking and dragging the mouse.

In addition, it can easily insert the necessary objects in the teaching and learning over the scanned images. It can be used as a tool for the teaching and learning of kindergarten, elementary, middle and high schools. As well as, it can be widely utilized in publishing industry, public institutions, such as libraries that require high-scanning printing, and digital newspapers and related projects.

Established in 2011, 4DCULTURE provides domestic 3D scanning system and a related total solution. Through the continued development of 3D image processing technology and high-performance 3D scanning technology, it has provides the best products and services to customers around the world based on the domestic scanning technology. Also its 3D scanning technology has been used in the field of cultural property, architecture and archeology.

‘CES 2013’ is the world’s largest electronics exhibition hosted by home appliances Manufacturers Association(CEA) whose members are about 600 consumer electronics industry companies of US. In the exhibition, will be introduced all kinds of consumer products such as home network?Mobile?MP3 as well as Audio?Video?Car Audio?Hardware?Software?Satellite receiver?Telephone.

Meanwhile, Daegu Mobile Convergence Center will help 9 domestic mobile IT convergence companies booth lease and facility devices, counseling and interpretation, production shipping, product directory book, as part of national project ‘New Industry Mobile Convergence global competitiveness reinforcement.
